key_concepts: A mixture is two or more substances physically combined and not chemically combined
Homogeneous mixtures have uniform composition and properties throughout
In homogeneous mixtures the components cannot be distinguished
In heterogeneous mixtures the components can be easily distinguished
Mixtures can be classified as solid-solid, solid-liquid, or liquid-liquid combinations
Solid-solid mixtures contain two or more different solids such as mixed nuts or fruit sala
In solid-liquid mixtures heavier solid particles may settle at the bottom, as with sand an
Liquid-liquid mixtures contain two or more different liquids such as oil and water or vine
Some solid-liquid mixtures, like salt in water, appear as one phase
